review_kind: assistant semantic review, not human approval

cases.assessment: The original recording becomes an original little car, and transcription/translation become mutation. These are different objects/actions, despite preserved negation and 12 minutes.
Eleni is shortened to Ele. The two people remain distinct, and recipient, translator, recorder and subtitle roles are otherwise preserved.
The 5,000-sat quantity becomes malformed 5,00.000; the receipt clause is incoherent Greek. The 500-sat contrast and different-unit denial remain present.
The speaker denies saying all books were sold and instead says none were sold yesterday; a possible single sale today remains undecided.
The approval condition replaces Giannis with Antonios and does not preserve a coherent approval relation. The second segment separately retains Giannis, Friday and Monday.
The 12-or-21 chapter question, unknown answer and insufficiency of the title are preserved.

limits: Six previously exposed development cases; these classifications are diagnostic observations, not general translation error rates.
